title: TSMC Third-Quarter 2014 Earnings Conference Call
lineage: Third-party transcription hosted by the foundry. The statements represent the foundry’s account.

passages.locator: Printed p. 5, C. C. Wei’s remarks on the 16 nm ramp
passages.note: TSMC distinguishes 16FF and 16FF+, dates 16FF risk production to November 2013, and says 16FF+ entered risk production after 7 October 2014. TSMC reports yield learning from 20SoC and similarity apart from the transistor.
